LR_0.title: Prologue
LR_0.overview: The Straw Hats are forced to get a move-on after landing back in the ocean. The Five Elders discuss the behavior of a certain Marine Admiral.

WA_61.title: The Sweet Bean Code
WA_61.overview: The sound of lightning rumbles as Big Mom prepares to test out her newest Homie. Meanwhile, down on the second floor, Usopp, Nami, Tama and Komachiyo continue trying (and failing) to get a very angry Page One off their tail.

cover_03.release_label: The Adventures of the Straw Hats

specials_02.custom_overview: Having been propelled onto an unknown island by Luffy, Wapol experiences life as a homeless man for the first time. Eventually, he uses his Baku Baku powers to create unique toys by fusing different objects together and begins to work his way back up the social ladder by selling these toys to children. In the end, he opens his own shop and marries `Miss Universe` Kinderella.

specials_03.custom_overview: Three years before the beginning of the Golden Age of Piracy, word arrives at Marineford that Shiki and the Roger Pirates have made contact at Edd War in the New World. Monkey D. Garp, hearing the news, heads off with Sengoku to meet them.

specials_04.custom_overview: A series of shorts featuring the Straw Hats parodying various genres, such as fairy tales and science-fiction.

specials_05.custom_overview: This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Anne has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.

specials_06.custom_overview: [April Fools 2017] Luffy's team -- plus a stowaway -- sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji. Meanwhile, the leading families and leaders of the world make their way to the Holy Land, Mary Geoise, for a pivotal round table conference.

specials_07.custom_overview: [April Fools 2021] The Straw Hats venture to the fabled 'Treasure Island' to discover riches, adventure, and... strange creatures. Oh, and everything is in Klingon for some reason.

specials_08.custom_overview: [April Fools 2023][Dragon Ball Super] The stage is set for an epic battle as the greatest warriors from different universes gather to fight for their survival. Get ready for an unforgettable fight like no other, as this episode will have you holding your breath to the very end.

specials_09.custom_title: The Desert Doo Doo Hits the Fan
specials_09.custom_overview: [April Fools 2024] When Crocodile yells 'Oh no! Water!' it's game over! Join Monkey D. Luffy and his courageous crew -- Nami, Usopp, Chopper (who does doctoring), Sanji, and Zolo -- as they save Alabasta from the crooked clutches of Baroque Works!

specials_10.custom_title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!
specials_10.custom_overview: [April Fools 2025] The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and crew's voyage to the Grand Line.The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and crew's voyage to the Grand Line.
